blurb: Guests can choose from activities such as ATV tours, mountain biking, rock climbing, horseback riding, rafting, kayaking, snowmobiling, ballooning, and more. Many adventures include lessons, clinics, and gear rentals. Deposits are required to book, and cancellations have specific refund policies.
extraNote: 50% activity deposit required to confirm booking · One-day adventures require $50 per person deposit; two-day require $100 per person deposit · Cancellations 15 days or more before trip get 100% refund; no refund less than 15 days · Date changes cost $25 per person · Cancellations after deadline subject to fees of 25% or full cost · Summer/Fall (June-November) and Winter/Spring (November-May)
